facts.headline: Ukraine's Pursuit of Ceasefire Amid Global Instabilities
facts.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's diplomatic push in Saudi Arabia reframes the search for a Ukraine ceasefire as part of a wider system of strain—shifting U.S. calculations, European pressure, energy and food markets, and a fragmenting global order in which no single negotiation stands alone.
